skills.name: Thunder Fist (震拳)
skills.line: Hey, I'm not an evil god, don't run!
skills.description: Bishamonten attacks a single target dealing damage equal to 100% of his ATK.

upgrades.text: Damage increases to 120%, gain 1 stack of Fortune Might.

skills.name: Discipline (戒•定•慧)
skills.line: You lot, get over here and train together
skills.description: Exclusive only. Elephant Drum is awakened and sustained for 3 turns. When Elephant Drum is present, gain 1 onibi, 2 stacks of Fortune Might and increase all allies move bar by 20%. ;Fortune Might (福威) ; :'''Buff''', '''Mark''': Up to 5 stacks. Each stack increases Effect RES by 30%. ;Heart Drum (心鼓) ; ;'''Buff, Mark''': Max 6 stacks, upon reaching the limit, remove all stacks and cast Discipline with no cost. This triggers up to 3 times before Bishamonten's next turn. ;Elephant Drum (象鼓) ; :While on the field, 50% of the damage Bishamonten takes is evenly shared by other allies as transferred damage. This damage is non-lethal, does not trigger souls or passive effects, and transferred damage cannot trigger again. When triggered, gain 1 stack of Heart Drum. ;Sustain (维持) :A status or mark will last depending on the number of turns of the originator, and not target. ;Lose (失去) :Not like receiving damage, lost HP cannot Crit, is not absorbed by shields and does not trigger damage related effects. When a shikigami loses most of their HP and/or continues to lose more HP, their remaining cannot drop below 1 HP.

upgrades.text: When Elephant Drum sounds, the 2 enemies with the lowest HP ratio lose 10% of their max HP, up to 100% of Bishamonten's starting ATK.
When an enemy loses HP, Bishamonten gains 1 stack of Heart Drum (max 6 stacks per action)
While Elephant Drum is on the field, this unit shares 30% of the single-target damage allies take.

skills.name: Heavenshaker Staff (撼天伏魔棍)
skills.line: Bear a thousand weights, ring out boundless blessings!
skills.description: Consume all Fortune Might to attack the enemy target, dealing 300% ATK damage, with the damage multiplier increasing by 30% for each Fortune Might consumed. After use, before the start of the next turn, Elephant Drum is triggered and move bar is increased by 20%. ;Fortune Might (福威) ; :'''Buff''', '''Mark''': Up to 5 stacks. Each stack increases Effect RES by 30%. ;Elephant Drum (象鼓) ; :While on the field, 50% of the damage Bishamonten takes is evenly shared by other allies as transferred damage. This damage is non-lethal, does not trigger souls or passive effects, and transferred damage cannot trigger again. When triggered, gain 1 stack of Heart Drum.

upgrades.text: Damage increased to 330%, with each stack's Fortune Might coefficient boost increased to 35%.
While Elephant Drum is on the field, onibi cost is reduced by 1.
Damage increased to 360%, with each stack's Fortune Might coefficient boost increased to 40%.
If the damage dealt during the attack is absorbed, shared or nullified, immediately gain 3 stacks of Fortune Might and attack the same target 1 more time. This effect does not trigger consecutively.
